next.headline: 8220 Gang: a threat actor known by several names
next.in_short: The ETDA catalogue lists 8220 Gang, also called 8220 Mining Group, Returned Libra and Water Sigbin. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: The ETDA catalogue lists a threat actor called 8220 Gang.
The same record gives three other names for it: 8220 Mining Group, Returned Libra and Water Sigbin.
No public report in this library describes its operations.
